caption: Figure 5 | Prediction-interval coverage and width in the primary United States/Canada evaluation. (A) Station-month coverage pools covered/tested station-months. (B) Whole-station coverage pools test stations whose entire observed sequence is covered, divided by tested stations. (C) Mean width is weighted by test station-month counts, in µg m⁻³. All 64 primary folds have finite calibration thresholds. The 16 country–task–profile groups contain five folds for T1/T2 tasks and one for T3 2022 forward-year validation. Meteorological profiles are offset within country/task rows; vertical reference lines mark nominal 90% coverage. Fold detail and the separate feasibility construction are in Supplementary Figure S2.
